title: rosa sempervirens var. microphylla
intro: Rosa sempervirens var. microphylla, commonly known as the dwarf alpine rose, is a low-growing, woody shrub native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its rich content of bioactive constituents, which have been reported to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa sempervirens var. microphylla include soothing and calming effects, which can help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
